project.project_name: 晴野 CLEARFIELD 600ml 保温杯 · 腾讯信息流广告
project.platform: 腾讯信息流广告 / 手机端
project.core_narrative: 城市出发 → 进入山野 → 冷热饮用 → 跨越昼夜 → 次日依然恒温
project.communication_principle: 无声观看也能完整理解产品卖点

product_identity.description: Tall, slender cylindrical insulated bottle with straight sides and no tapering. Uniform matte sage-green powder-coated finish on body and cap. Brushed stainless steel circular top plate on lid. Integrated rectangular loop handle on cap side, same green material.

body.aspect_ratio: high — significantly taller than wide, consistent with 600ml portable capacity

lid.type: screw-on cap, same diameter as body
lid.top_surface: flat circular brushed stainless steel plate
lid.side_finish: slightly glossier than body, same sage green color

handle.position: protrudes from one side of lid

lid.seam: distinct horizontal seam where lid meets bottle body
lid.height_ratio: lid approximately 1/5 of total bottle height

content.graphic: thin horizontal wavy line between English and Chinese text, resembling stylized mountain or wave

logo.font: clean white sans-serif, English in all caps
logo.placement: near bottom of bottle front face, centered
logo.size: small relative to bottle height — match product reference exactly
logo.visibility: visible on front and 3/4 views only; back view has no logo

inner_rim.visibility: visible from top view at opening

scale_reference.real_world_size: standard 600ml portable thermos — must fit naturally in normal outdoor backpack side pocket without appearing oversized or unnaturally small
scale_reference.human_hand_ratio: held comfortably in one adult hand
scale_reference.backpack_side_pocket: must enter completely and naturally — not forced, not floating, not visibly too large for pocket

files.description: Multi-angle product sheet: front, side, back, top, and 3/4 views on white background. Definitive source for shape, color, logo placement, lid structure, handle, and proportions.

product_references.usage_rule: All scenes must render CLEARFIELD matching this reference. Product reference overrides style reference whenever conflict occurs.

style_references.priority: art direction only — does NOT define product identity

muted earthy palette: forest green, slate grey, cream, beige
shallow depth of field isolating subject
quiet luxury outdoor aesthetic, serene and aspirational
sense of travel and exploration
bright diffused high-altitude daylight, wrap-around soft light
desaturated earthy tones: slate grey, sage green, limestone white
very shallow depth of field, intimate first-person feel
frame-within-a-frame via tent opening
functional gear shown in active use
serene post-activity reward atmosphere

files.primary_use: forest hiking / drinking action / character reference
extracted_qualities: soft diffused daylight in shaded forest, balanced exposure
organic palette: deep forest green, cool stone grey, muted earth tones
shallow DOF, subjects sharp, background foliage softly blurred
medium shot, rule-of-thirds placement
natural drinking action mid-use
contemporary technical hiking apparel on young East Asian subjects
refreshing, serene, authentic outdoor lifestyle

style_references.usage_rule: Extract lighting, color, atmosphere, composition, and photography style only. Do NOT copy products, brands, logos, or packaging visible in style references.

global_visual_direction.source: Synthesized from style references IMG_0863, IMG_0865, IMG_0872, IMG_0882; aligned with master script direction
global_visual_direction.overall_aesthetic: Premium outdoor lifestyle commercial — clean, restrained, authentic, young urban outdoor sensibility. Combines lifestyle advertising atmosphere with clear product demonstration.

lighting.primary_quality: natural daylight, predominantly soft and diffused

scene_variants.urban_morning: clean morning natural light entering interior space — bright, fresh, low harshness (per master script)
scene_variants.open_mountain: directional warm sunlight with visible shadows on terrain — golden-hour accent possible (ref: IMG_0863)
scene_variants.forest_shaded: soft diffused overcast or canopy-filtered light, medium-low contrast (ref: IMG_0882, IMG_0865)
scene_variants.alpine_camping: bright diffused high-altitude light, wrap-around, neutral to slightly cool (ref: IMG_0872)
scene_variants.night_timelapse: natural night sky progression with tent interior warm accent light

accent: subtle maroon or dusty purple in clothing — optional, not required
color_palette.product_color: muted sage green — fixed, from product reference
color_palette.grading: naturalistic, slightly desaturated, filmic but restrained — not hyper-saturated or neon

color_technical.contrast: medium-low in shaded/forest/interior scenes; medium-high in open sunlit mountain scenes
color_technical.color_temperature: neutral to slightly warm in sunlit open scenes; neutral to slightly cool in alpine/high-altitude scenes

global_visual_direction.atmosphere: Fresh, adventurous, serene, aspirational quiet-outdoor-luxury. Real camping and hiking life, not staged studio outdoors.

photography_style.depth_of_field: shallow to medium — subjects and product sharp, backgrounds naturally softened
photography_style.texture_emphasis: matte technical fabrics, natural rock/grass/forest surfaces, organic environmental detail
photography_style.motion: authentic human movement preferred over static posing
photography_style.restraint: cinematic but restrained — not overly stylized or hyper-commercial

composition_tendencies.framing: medium shots and medium close-ups for character+product; product hero shots centered
composition_tendencies.human_product_relationship: functional and integrated — product shown in natural use during outdoor activity, not isolated studio object

environmental_feeling.urban: clean modern city residence, morning light, young couple preparing for weekend outdoors
environmental_feeling.transition: sense of journey from city to nature
environmental_feeling.mountain_trail: lush green alpine meadows, dirt trails, vast mountain ridges
environmental_feeling.forest: dense green foliage, rocky resting spots
environmental_feeling.camping: tent beside rocks, open mountain vista, night sky, sunrise over peaks

female.role: primary product user — pours water, inserts bottle in pocket, hikes, drinks, places bottle, re-drinks after night
female.appearance: young adult, fit, healthy — East Asian appearance consistent with style reference IMG_0882
female.wardrobe: contemporary casual-to-technical outdoor clothing appropriate to each scene (urban morning casual → hiking technical layers)

male.role: lifestyle background / companion — packs gear, walks alongside, hikes
male.appearance: young adult, fit, healthy — East Asian appearance consistent with style reference IMG_0882
male.wardrobe: contemporary technical hiking apparel — light jacket, cap optional, outdoor shorts or pants

consistency_rules: Same two characters throughout all scenes
Wardrobe may change logically between urban morning and outdoor scenes
Characters serve as lifestyle context — visual priority always on CLEARFIELD product
Natural, unposed body language and authentic movement

mobile_composition_rules.product_visibility: Product must be clearly identifiable on small mobile screens in every scene where it appears

text.size: 明显偏大 — all on-screen text must be large enough to read without zooming on mobile feed
text.placement: within visual safe zones, not cropped by platform UI
text.hierarchy: one primary message per scene — avoid complex multi-line information stacks
text.function: 文字只强化关键信息，不代替画面叙事

mobile_composition_rules.action_clarity: Core actions must be understandable without sound — pouring, inserting in pocket, hiking, drinking, timelapse, hero product reveal
mobile_composition_rules.scene_discipline: Each scene carries exactly one primary communication task
mobile_composition_rules.safe_area: Keep critical product and text away from top/bottom edges where platform UI may overlay — exact pixel margins unspecified

scene_01.title: 清晨 · 城市家中 · 出发
scene_01.narrative_purpose: Establish 600ml capacity and side-pocket portability — 装得够，同时好携带
scene_01.environment: Modern urban apartment/residence interior, weekend morning packing scene
scene_01.time_of_day: 清晨 — early morning natural light

characters.female: pours water into CLEARFIELD, picks up filled bottle, inserts into backpack side pocket
characters.male: packing outdoor gear in background as lifestyle context

scene_01.product_state: Empty → being filled with water → full, capped, inserted in backpack side pocket
action_sequence: Morning natural light enters urban home
Couple packing weekend outdoor gear — characters as lifestyle background
Female pours water into CLEARFIELD thermos
Brief translucent cup cross-section visual overlay showing volume + large '600ml' text
Female picks up filled thermos and smoothly inserts it into outdoor backpack side pocket
Cut to product close-up showing credible scale relationship between 600ml bottle and side pocket — bottle enters completely, naturally, without appearing bulky

camera.movement: stable with gentle push-in toward product during close-up
camera.focus: visual priority always on CLEARFIELD — characters soft background when appropriate

composition.key_frame: close-up of bottle entering backpack side pocket — scale relationship clearly readable on mobile
composition.aspect_ratio: 9:16 vertical — product centered or upper-center in close-up

scene_01.lighting: Clean morning natural light entering through windows — bright, fresh, soft shadows (master script + urban morning variant from global_visual_direction)

transition.note: end on product-in-pocket close-up or medium shot ready for match cut anchor

cross_section_overlay.type: 简洁的半透明杯体剖面视觉

reference_usage.product_reference: gemini-产品图 copy.jpeg — definitive bottle shape, color, logo, lid, handle for all product renders
reference_usage.style_reference: IMG_0882 — soft natural interior-adjacent daylight quality; IMG_0865 — clean restrained lifestyle feel

consistency_requirements: CLEARFIELD must match product reference exactly
600ml bottle must appear full adult-hand scale
Side pocket insertion must look physically credible — not shrunk product
Logo visible on front-facing product angles
negative_constraints: Do not shrink bottle to exaggerate portability
Do not show bottle failing to fit or appearing comically large
Do not redesign product based on style references
Do not use exaggerated studio lighting

scene_02.title: 城市 → 山野 · Match Cut
scene_02.narrative_purpose: Visual transition from city departure to outdoor adventure — product as constant anchor
scene_02.environment: Urban street → open mountain wilderness — seamless spatial transition

characters.female: carries backpack with CLEARFIELD in side pocket, walks with male

scene_02.product_state: secured in backpack side pocket, visible throughout
action_sequence: Female shoulders backpack, couple exits together
Camera gradually locks onto CLEARFIELD in backpack side pocket
Match Cut: bottle + backpack position + walking direction held constant
Environment rapidly transitions: city street → open mountain landscape
CLEARFIELD remains stable in side pocket throughout transition
scene_02.shot_type: tracking medium shot tightening to product anchor frame

camera.movement: follow walk, then stabilize on side pocket product anchor for match cut

composition.visual_anchor: CLEARFIELD in backpack side pocket — fixed reference point for match cut
composition.aspect_ratio: 9:16 — bottle in side pocket occupies clear readable zone

lighting.urban: soft morning city daylight (ref: IMG_0865 — diffused, muted)
lighting.mountain: opens to warm directional mountain light (ref: IMG_0863 — golden natural sunlight on green terrain)

transition.mechanism: Fixed product/backpack anchor with environment swap

scene_02.key_message: 从城市出走，进入山野 — conveyed purely through visual transition, no text required

reference_usage.product_reference: gemini-产品图 copy.jpeg — bottle in side pocket must match product identity
reference_usage.style_reference: IMG_0865 — journey/transition mood and soft urban light; IMG_0863 — open mountain destination lighting and green landscape

consistency_requirements: Bottle size in side pocket must match scene_01 scale exactly
No product redesign during environment transition
Walking motion feels continuous across cut
negative_constraints: Do not break match cut alignment — bottle must not jump position or scale
Do not copy car/mirror composition from IMG_0865 — extract mood only
No text overlay — scene communicates through visual storytelling alone

scene_03.title: 山野活动 · 冷 × 热
scene_03.narrative_purpose: Establish cold/hot dual insulation capability — 冷热皆宜 · 持久恒温
scene_03.environment: Open mountain trail / alpine meadow — expansive outdoor hiking setting

characters.female: retrieves CLEARFIELD from side pocket and drinks while hiking

scene_03.product_state: in use — drinking; then split into cold/hot visual states; merges back to single bottle
action_sequence: Couple hiking in open mountain landscape
Female naturally retrieves CLEARFIELD from backpack side pocket
Female drinks from bottle while walking
Split Screen activates — left and right halves
Left: cold drink state — restrained cool cup surface, light condensation/fresh vapor, cool-toned environment feedback
Right: hot drink state — subtle natural steam, warm environment feedback
Both sides show IDENTICAL CLEARFIELD product shape and proportions
Split Screen merges back into single CLEARFIELD bottle
shot_type: merge to single product medium close-up

camera.movement: steady follow during hike; static during split screen
camera.focus: product sharp in all split-screen panels

split_screen.product_consistency: identical CLEARFIELD on both sides — same shape, size, color, logo position
split_screen.differentiation: environmental and surface-state cues only (cold vs warm) — NOT different product designs

lighting.left_panel: slightly cooler color temperature, crisp clarity
lighting.right_panel: slightly warmer color temperature, soft warmth

lines.text: 冷热皆宜 · 持久恒温
lines.timing: during or after split screen merge

scene_03.key_message: 快速建立「冷/热都能够稳定保温」的认知，为 24H 长效恒温证明铺垫

left_cold_cues: light fresh condensation or cool vapor
split_screen.merge: both panels collapse back to single CLEARFIELD

reference_usage.product_reference: gemini-产品图 copy.jpeg — BOTH split panels must use identical product identity
reference_usage.style_reference: IMG_0863 — open mountain hiking energy and lighting; IMG_0882 — natural drinking action and medium-shot framing

consistency_requirements: Split screen left and right must show the SAME CLEARFIELD design — not two variants
Product shape, logo, color, lid, handle unchanged across panels
Cold/hot differentiation through atmosphere and subtle surface cues only
negative_constraints: Do not create two different bottle designs for left/right panels
Do not copy the clear plastic bottle from IMG_0882 — use CLEARFIELD product reference only
Do not over-exaggerate steam or frost effects
No additional text beyond specified on-screen copy

scene_04.title: 黄昏 → 次日清晨 · 24H 恒温证明
scene_04.narrative_purpose: Prove 24-hour temperature retention through time passage — 24H 长效恒温
scene_04.environment: Mountain campsite — tent beside rock, open vista, night sky, sunrise
scene_04.time_of_day: 黄昏 → 日落 → 夜幕 → 星空/星轨 → 深夜 → 天空渐亮 → 黎明 → 次日日出

characters.female: places bottle on rock at dusk, exits frame; re-enters at sunrise to pick up and drink
characters.male: unspecified — not required in this scene per script

scene_04.product_state: placed stationary on rock → unchanged through timelapse → picked up, opened, drunk from at sunrise
action_sequence: Evening: female arrives at tent, casually places CLEARFIELD on rock, exits frame
Camera locks to fixed position — CLEARFIELD becomes sole visual anchor
Time-lapse sequence centered on product: dusk → sunset → night → stars/star trails → deep night → dawn light → sunrise
CLEARFIELD position, angle, scale, and appearance remain completely stable throughout
Tent in background lights up with warm interior glow after dark
Large mobile text '24H' and '长效恒温' appear near product as time progresses
Sunrise illuminates open mountain landscape
Female emerges from tent, picks up same CLEARFIELD, opens lid, drinks naturally against mountain backdrop
scene_04.shot_type: fixed locked-off wide/medium — product-centered timelapse, then medium action at sunrise

camera.movement: completely static during timelapse — no drift, no zoom, no reframing
camera.focus: CLEARFIELD sharp and stable at center of frame throughout timelapse

composition.anchor: CLEARFIELD on rock — dead center or upper-center of 9:16 frame
composition.background: tent + mountain vista + sky time progression

lighting.tent_accent: warm interior glow visible after dark — camping life authenticity (ref: IMG_0872 camping atmosphere)
lighting.product_lighting: product consistently lit readable at all times — not lost in darkness

lines.timing: appears alongside or after 24H during timelapse

scene_04.key_message: 经过漫长的一夜，饮用体验依然稳定 — understandable without sound

reference_usage.product_reference: gemini-产品图 copy.jpeg — product must not morph or drift during timelapse
reference_usage.style_reference: IMG_0872 — alpine camping atmosphere, tent context, serene post-activity feel; IMG_0863 — sunrise mountain landscape quality

consistency_requirements: Product absolutely static in frame position during timelapse — zero drift
Same bottle identity from dusk to sunrise
Drinking action at end must show same product as timelapse anchor
negative_constraints: Do not move camera during timelapse
Do not allow product to change size, color, or shape across time periods
Do not use exaggerated sci-fi time effects
Do not require sound to understand 24H message

scene_05.title: Ending · Hero Shot + Brand
scene_05.narrative_purpose: Brand closure — product hero reveal with slogan and CTA
scene_05.environment: Open sunlit mountain landscape — vast, clean, panoramic
scene_05.product_state: pristine hero presentation — full bottle, cap on, logo visible
action_sequence: Cut to CLEARFIELD hero shot
Product centered, complete, sharp, occupying visual center of 9:16 frame
Background: sunlit expansive clean mountain landscape
Brand logo graphic curve visually echoes/rhymes with distant mountain silhouette — 晴野 mountain-clearfield connection
Brand name, slogan, and CTA appear as on-screen text
scene_05.shot_type: product hero shot — medium close-up to medium, product-dominant

camera.focus: product tack sharp, background softly blurred

composition.background: sunlit open mountain vista — clean, uncluttered
composition.brand_graphic: logo curve aligned with mountain contour for visual rhyme
composition.text_zones: brand info and CTA in lower or upper safe zones, large mobile-readable type

scene_05.lighting: bright clean natural sunlight on product — fresh, premium, clear (ref: IMG_0863 open mountain light quality; master script hero direction)

lines.text: 陪你从城市出走，到山野的晴天。

scene_05.key_message: Brand identity closure — 晴野 CLEARFIELD as outdoor lifestyle companion from city to clear mountain day

product: AI 自行重新设计产品
